Key Features & Advantages

Unlimited Wire Rope Length

Self-gripping jaws pull wire rope continuously without drum spooling limitations.

Built-In Overload Shear Pins

Shear pins in the forward operating lever break if overloaded, while the load remains safely held by the reverse jaw.

Telescopic Operating Handle

Extendable lever reduces operator effort during heavy pulling operations.

Standards & Compliance

EN 13157 Compliance

Hand operated pulling machines.

CE Certified

150% proof load tested.

Product Overview

The Europull Wire Rope Winch is the premier portable rigging tool for tree extraction, vehicle recovery, machinery skidding, cable tensioning, and steel erection.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Wire Rope Winch are available?

The Europull Wire Rope Winch is available in 4 models: EP-TR08, EP-TR16, EP-TR32, EP-TR54. Lifting Capacity ranges from 800 kg to 5,400 kg. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Wire Rope Winch cover?

The Europull Wire Rope Winch covers 800kg - 5400kg.

Which standard does the Europull Wire Rope Winch comply with?

The Europull Wire Rope Winch is manufactured to EN 13157.

What wire Rope does the Europull Wire Rope Winch have?

The Europull Wire Rope Winch's wire Rope: 20m Steel Wire Rope with Safety Swivel Hook.

What safety Mechanism does the Europull Wire Rope Winch have?

The Europull Wire Rope Winch's safety Mechanism: Shear Pins for Built-In Overload Protection.

What housing does the Europull Wire Rope Winch have?

The Europull Wire Rope Winch's housing: Corrosion-Resistant High-Strength Cast Aluminum Alloy.
